newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.053PTS TO 103.439.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.053PTS TO 103.439.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.053 points in Thursday's trading to 103.439 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.803 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.045 points to 101.042, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.343 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.598 points to 1,018.720.
